query: Where was the sports complex at which Will Brodie made his debut in the thirty-five point loss against Melbourne located?

pipeline_result.response: The sports complex where Will Brodie made his debut in the thirty-five point loss against Melbourne was Traeger Park, located in Alice Springs, Northern Territory, Australia.
retrieved_context: Traeger Park: Traeger Park (currently known under naming rights as TIO Traeger Park) is a sports complex located in Alice Springs, Northern Territory, Australia, and is named after Alfred Hermann Traeger.  The park was officially opened by Anne Catherine Smallwood (nee Traeger) Alfred's younger daughter.  The primary stadium in the complex caters for Australian rules football and cricket and has a capacity of 10,000.  The complex also has a small baseball stadium.

Will Brodie: Will Brodie (born 23 August 1998) is a professional Australian rules footballer playing for the Gold Coast Football Club in the Australian Football League (AFL).  He was drafted by Gold Coast with their third selection and ninth overall in the 2016 national draft.  He made his debut in the thirty-five point loss against Melbourne at TIO Traeger Park in round ten of the 2017 season.
